principle: Atlas identity, execution proof and launch authority are independent. Reuse a canonical incarnation when identity is exact; keep semantic cousins review-only until equivalence is proven; record rejected aliases as composition reuse when a broader canonical product and bounded reusable component are established; require a new typed execution proof for genuine profile extensions.

changeproof.question: Does atlas ChangeProof mean only model, prompt, policy, connector and environment change assurance, or a broader enterprise change product?

homs_accreditation.reason: HOMS Accreditation is the education-facing incarnation of the broader DIO Accreditation composition. EducationAccreditationProof is a bounded regulated-market execution organ, not an identity alias.
homs_accreditation.next_gate: bind accreditation criterion identifiers through HOMS/VAMP/Evidex into a controlled programme evidence matrix and proof room, then run one human-reviewed programme pilot

dio_regops.reason: DIO RegOps spans operational prerequisites, evidence, deadlines and readiness gates. AIRegReadiness is the bounded AI regulatory-readiness incarnation and therefore only one reusable RegOps component/profile.
dio_regops.next_gate: prove a bounded RegOps readiness case over an explicit non-AI or mixed regulatory profile while preserving no-advice and human release gates

dio_ai_assurance.reason: DIO Assurance is the broader AI-governance assurance composition spanning inventory, controls, evidence, decisions, exceptions and review. AITrustProof is a bounded AI system trust and evaluation dossier, not an identity alias.
dio_ai_assurance.next_gate: bind one bounded AI workflow into the broader DIO Assurance control-evidence and review workflow while preserving human assurance and release authority

promotion_law.exact_canonical_incarnation: Identity reconciliation may reuse the canonical manifest and executor, but it does not by itself grant customer processing, public launch or external release authority.
promotion_law.equivalence_candidate: No alias or executor binding until an operator-approved scope equivalence decision is recorded.
promotion_law.resolved_composition_binding: Rejecting identity equivalence may record a broader canonical product and bounded reusable component, but composition reuse grants no maturity, customer processing, public launch or external release authority.
promotion_law.genuine_profile_extension: Requires a typed product profile, controlled fixture, actual execution receipt, reviewed output and public-safe proof before controlled-pilot launch consideration.
